stories.title: Korkunç olay... Çift ölü bulundu! "Evde siyanür var, girmeyin" notu

en.title: Horrific incident... Couple found dead! Note reading "Cyanide in house, do not enter"
en.summary: A separated couple in Karaman, Namık Özcan aged 53 and Fatma Özcan aged 45, were found dead in their home after their children could not reach them.

stories.title: Cumhuriyet Silivri'den bildiriyor... İBB davasında 87. gün: Gözaltına alınan Ümit Boyner'in oğlu Mithat Sinan Bolak kürsüde

en.title: Cumhuriyet reports from Silivri... Day 87 in İBB case: Son of Ümit Boyner, Mithat Sinan Bolak, takes the stand
en.summary: The trial against 435 defendants in the İBB case, including detained Mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu, continued on its 87th day with Mithat Sinan Bolak, son of former TÜSİAD chairman Ümit Boyner, appearing as a defendant.

stories.title: Ankara'da tıp tarihine geçen ameliyat: İç organları ters doğan 5 yaşındaki Ömer sağlığına kavuştu

en.title: Surgery that made medical history in Ankara: 5-year-old Ömer, born with reversed internal organs, recovered
en.summary: A 5-year-old boy with internal organs positioned in reverse and abnormal heart vessel connections underwent a complex 6-hour surgery using 3D imaging techniques, resulting in successful recovery.

stories.title: Organları ters, kalp damarları farklıydı: 5 yaşındaki Ömer’in hayatını değiştiren ameliyat

en.title: Organs reversed, heart vessels different: Surgery that changed 5-year-old Ömer's life
en.summary: A 5-year-old boy with mirrored internal organs and abnormal heart vessel connections underwent life-changing surgery.

stories.title: Şanlıurfa’da deprem riski sürüyor mu? Prof. Dr. Övgün Ahmet Ercan açıkladı

en.title: Is earthquake risk continuing in Şanlıurfa? Prof. Dr. Övgün Ahmet Ercan explained
en.summary: A seismologist stated that an earthquake in Şanlıurfa occurred on the Bozova Fault and indicated it was not a foreshock, with no expectation of a larger earthquake from that fault.

stories.title: Karaman'da şüpheli ölüm: 'Evde siyanür var girmeyin' notu polisi alarma geçirdi

en.title: Suspicious death in Karaman: 'There is cyanide in the house, do not enter' note alarmed police
en.summary: Police discovered a tragic scene after children reported a divorcing couple missing in Karaman, with a note warning of cyanide presence found at the residence.

stories.title: Şanlıurfa’da okullar tatil mi? Deprem sonrası valilikten açıklama

en.title: Are schools closed in Şanlıurfa? Statement from the governorate after the earthquake
en.summary: Following an earthquake in Şanlıurfa felt in neighboring provinces, the regional governor announced that all educational institutions and daycare centers would be closed on September 24th.

stories.title: Şanlıurfa'da okullar bir gün tatil edildi

en.title: Schools in Şanlıurfa closed for one day
en.summary: A magnitude 5.4 earthquake occurred in Karaköprü district of Şanlıurfa, causing tremors felt across the region and surrounding areas.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA! Alihan Kuriş suç örgütü soruşturmasında yeni gelişme: 20 tutuklama

en.title: Breaking News! New Development in Alihan Kuriş Criminal Organization Investigation: 20 Arrested
en.summary: Turkish authorities arrested 20 of 25 suspects detained in an investigation into a criminal organization led by Alihan Kuriş, with the remaining 5 suspects released pending judicial review.

stories.title: Son Dakika... Alihan Kuriş soruşturmasında yeni gelişme: 20 şüpheli tutuklandı

en.title: Breaking News... New Development in Alihan Kuriş Investigation: 20 Suspects Arrested
en.summary: Ankara prosecutors arrested 20 out of 25 suspects held in custody regarding the criminal organization investigation involving Alihan Kuriş.

stories.title: "Alihan Kuriş çıkar amaçlı suç örgütü" soruşturmasında 20 şüpheli tutuklandı

en.title: 20 Suspects Arrested in "Alihan Kuriş Criminal Organization for Profit" Investigation
en.summary: Twenty of 25 suspects detained during operations against the Alihan Kuriş criminal organization were ordered arrested by a court, while 5 others received judicial supervision orders.

stories.title: Sermaye piyasası soruşturmasında 21 şüpheli adliyeye sevk edildi

en.title: 21 Suspects Referred to Prosecutor in Capital Markets Investigation
en.summary: Turkish authorities referred 21 suspects to prosecutors in an investigation concerning trading activities in capital markets.

stories.title: BioNTech'in kurucuları yeni şirket kuruyor: Uğur Şahin ve Özlem Türeci'den Arife hamlesi

en.title: BioNTech founders launching new company: Uğur Şahin and Özlem Türeci's Arife move
en.summary: BioNTech founders Uğur Şahin and Özlem Türeci are establishing a new biotechnology company called Arife in Mainz, Germany, focused on mRNA therapies for cancer treatment. The founders plan to leave their management positions at BioNTech by the end of 2026.

stories.title: Konut fiyatları enflasyona yenildi ama kiralar yükseldi

en.title: Housing prices lost to inflation but rents rose
en.summary: Home sale prices in three major Turkish cities lagged behind inflation rates, while rental prices increased significantly in Istanbul but declined in Ankara and Izmir. The gap between buying and renting 100 square meter apartments has widened.

stories.title: Çinli yapay zeka devi hız kesmiyor: 1 milyar dolara ulaştı

en.title: Chinese artificial intelligence giant shows no signs of slowing: reached 1 billion dollars
en.summary: DeepSeek, a Chinese AI company reshaping the industry, more than doubled its annualized revenue to 1 billion dollars in just months. The company is preparing for a new investment round and reportedly readying for a listing on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

stories.title: Trabzon'da heyelan: Toprak altında kalan kişi öldü

en.title: Landslide in Trabzon: Person buried under soil dies
en.summary: A 50-year-old person died after being buried by a landslide that occurred during construction work around a house in Trabzon's Ortahisar district.

stories.title: Hazine 1,5 milyar dolarlık ESG tahvil ihracını tamamladı

en.title: Treasury Completes 1.5 Billion Dollar ESG Bond Issuance
en.summary: The Treasury and Finance Ministry completed an issuance of 1.5 billion dollars in sustainable bonds maturing in 2037. The bonds, which attracted demand exceeding three times the issuance amount from over 100 investors, yielded 7.65 percent.
